sampling_model.design: Independent multinomial sampling of the complete observed path \(W=(X_1,X_2,X_3,X_4,D)\).
sampling_model.treatment: Binary \(D\), with treatment beginning after date \(2\).
sampling_model.overlap: Every mixing, conditional assignment, and transition probability in the proposal-specific model lies in \([\eta,1-\eta]\).
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: The empirical thirty-two-cell path PMF is inverted over all thirty-two labeled one-collision branches; no relative alignment is selected before projection.

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: Proposition 4 identifies the model parameters under RSM, M, and ID; Proposition 5 and Corollary 1 identify LTATT and aggregate ATT under the paper's stated TI--LT regular conditions.
Theorem 1 identifies type-specific initial distributions, transition kernels, and type probabilities up to a common permutation from four consecutive observations under Assumptions 1--3.
Sections 3.2--3.4 formulate model comparison, implicit observable constraints, identification, and bounding for polynomial latent-variable models through real quantifier elimination.
Cylindrical algebraic decomposition gives an exact quantifier-elimination method for formulas over real closed fields.
CAD-based real quantifier elimination has doubly exponential worst-case dependence on dimension, while other real-algebraic methods address selected tasks with different bounds.
A rational inverse and semialgebraic membership conditions characterize regular parts of a single binary hidden Markov model, with exceptional cases treated as lower-dimensional submodels.
Discrete causal bounds can be posed as polynomial programs and approximated by spatial branch-and-bound with certified outer bounds and \(\epsilon\)-sharpness.
Finite mixtures are exactly partially identified under an excluded source of mixture-weight variation using probability restrictions.
Criterion inversion yields confidence regions for identified sets and their images under stated pointwise and uniform conditions.

body.tldr: On the compact binary four-period latent-transition model, the singular case with distinct treated terminal rows and exactly one collided control terminal row admits an exact observable treatment. Terminal splitting reduces the forty-coordinate existential fiber to displayed ten-variable systems and exactly thirty-two collided-state, orientation, and relative-alignment branches. A Collins-style sign certificate is necessary and sufficient for branch feasibility and aggregate-ATT point identification; the associated exact algorithm returns the attained, possibly disconnected image with Thom-encoded endpoints, latent witnesses, and discarded-branch certificates. An explicit injective one-parameter family of one-collision laws has exactly two separated quotient ATT values throughout, with a dense rational subfamily. This proves positive-dimensional persistence, not relative openness in the full collision variety. The contribution is the structural reduction and causal certificate grammar, not a generic CAD complexity improvement, a completion of the other collision patterns, or an overlap theorem for Ahn--Kasahara's regular class.

project_justification.gap: Ahn--Kasahara's parameter and ATT identification results impose their stated RSM, M, ID, and TI--LT regular conditions, while Higgins and Jochmans's four-observation theorem requires rank, type-separation, and connectivity conditions; neither classifies the one-collided-control-row merger stratum or supplies an explicit positive-dimensional family with two aggregate-ATT values. Geiger--Meek and Collins supply general real quantifier elimination but leave the economically meaningful two-arm branch structure opaque.
project_justification.niche: Exactly one collided control terminal row is the first nonregular stratum on which full-path splitting, rank failure, probability-box contact, and relative treatment-control alignment interact but remain reducible to ten variables. Within it, an explicitly parameterized observed-law path permits a direct persistence proof without a generic or relative-open claim.
project_justification.fill: The project proves the reduction, gives the observable \(\mathscr L_{k_0,\sigma}\) classification, computes the exact attained ATT image on all thirty-two labeled branches, and supplies an injective one-parameter one-collision family whose two quotient ATT values remain separated, including a dense rational subfamily.

body.related_work: Ahn--Kasahara is the closest econometric comparator in the same full-path latent-transition architecture: their parameter and ATT results operate under their stated regular conditions. Those results motivate the estimand and architecture here; the compact class \(\mathcal M_\eta\) and its singular one-collision stratum are not asserted to equal, contain, or extend the Ahn--Kasahara identification class, and only the architecture and ATT formula transfer as motivation. Higgins and Jochmans give a four-observation Markov-mixture identification benchmark under rank, separation, and connectivity conditions, but do not classify a two-arm alignment fiber with one collided control terminal row. Critch's binary hidden Markov geometry motivates rational splitting and semialgebraic membership, but has neither two treatment arms nor a causal alignment functional. Geiger--Meek and Collins provide generic real quantifier elimination and exact CAD certification; they do not provide the model-specific ten-coordinate reduction, branch labels, ATT image, or endpoint representations. Basu supplies the relevant worst-case real-algebraic complexity benchmark. Duarte, Finkelstein, Knox, Mummolo, and Shpitser motivate polynomial optimization for discrete causal bounds, while the present object is an exact attained semialgebraic image. Henry, Kitamura, and Salanie study a different exclusion-driven finite-mixture set. Romano--Shaikh motivates set inversion; the finite-sample coverage theorem here is auxiliary and appendix-tier and asserts neither endpoint nor Hausdorff consistency. The persistence evidence is exactly the explicit injective one-parameter family proved here, not a relatively open chamber in a larger collision variety.
body.technical_internal_limitation: The completed object is the compact stratum with distinct treated terminal rows and exactly one collided control terminal row. Laws whose global compact fiber also contains representations from another collision pattern are outside this class. The exact certificate uses Collins-style projection after the model-specific reduction and may retain generic worst-case real-quantifier-elimination cost. The benchmark proves persistence only along its explicit one-dimensional observed-law family; it does not prove that these laws form a relatively open subset of the full collision variety.
body.honest_scope: The quotient semantics, forty-to-ten reduction, thirty-two-branch classification, exact stratum-restricted region, explicit positive-dimensional disconnected persistence family, and auxiliary appendix-tier finite-sample coverage result are the completed claims. The remaining open content is whether the complete CAD projection list can be compressed to a strictly smaller, sufficient, economically interpretable, and irredundant observable sign basis; no irredundancy result is claimed. Ahn--Kasahara's regular identification results are comparators only: no internal overlap-equality, model-inclusion, or regular-chart theorem is claimed. No result is claimed for the other terminal-collision strata, for an unboxed singular class, for relative openness of the benchmark family in a larger collision variety, or for Hausdorff consistency.
